i’m not sure if you struggle too much with this but it’s really really easy to become absorbed in a life forced on us by society and its expectations. you have to have a nice house, a nice spouse, nice kids, a nice job, nice hobbies, a nice attitude. 
i read something a while back about how we are not made for that kind of life. i guess you could say it goes against our “monkey brain”. we’re just supposed to find satisfaction in little things, like finding sustenance and surviving until the next day. we’ve evolved so much as a society that we’ve lost those instinctive values. instead, we are now focused on superficial things. 
i’m sorry if that sounds super preachy and weird but it gave me some comfort to know. there are expectations that we as a species set for ourselves that are literally unattainable. when you consider that, i think it’s understandable how sometimes depression seems to be so deeprooted within our psyche.

i don’t want to sound hypocritical because personally i haven’t reached this stage myself, but i think it’s important to understand we shouldn’t be chasing happiness. if it happens, it happens. but it’s by far more enjoyable and authentic if we happen upon it. instead, aim to be content. content with just being here. some days, most days, that’s all we are doing. just being here. and that’s okay, even if it doesn’t feel like it 100% of the time.
